statement: The population of a town is modeled by $P(t) = 52{,}000(1.03)^t$, where $t$ is the number of years after 2024. To the nearest whole person, what population does the model predict for 2028?

choices.misconception: I counted the years 2024, 2025, 2026, 2027 and 2028 as five years, so I used t = 5, but 2028 is only 4 years after 2024.
I treated the 3% as 0.3, so I used 1.3 as the growth factor and computed 52,000 times 1.3 to the 4th power.
I multiplied 1.03 by 4 instead of raising it to the 4th power, and 52,000 times 4.12 is 214,240.

hints: Substitute $t = 4$, and remember that the exponent applies only to $1.03$.
author: Devansh Sanghavi
